answer_pt: Implementei scripts em Python (pandas) que cruzaram dados via APIs (TIM e fornecedores terceirizados) para identificar inconsistências em datas de instalação de fibra. This way, I managed to apply my core study technologies in a single project and, furthermore, the project allowed me to improve my skills in API design and practice with AWS services, resulting in a final product I'm very proud of.

I'm impressed by how the possibilities in various aspects of life expand as technology advances, whether in development, health, food, or any aspect of life. What motivates me is wanting to be part of the process of changing people's lives, and learning from the challenges and difficulties along the way.
answer_es: Lo que más me motiva sobre la tecnología hoy es la innovación constante. Me impresiona la manera en que las posibilidades de diversas vertientes de la vida se expanden conforme avanzan las tecnologías, ya sea en desarrollo, salud, alimentación o cualquier aspecto de la vida. Lo que me motiva es querer formar parte del proceso de cambio en la vida de las personas, y aprender con los desafíos y dificultades en el camino.
